title: Pure Mathmech
summary: The pure Level 4 Cyberse Mathmech Synchro and Rank 4 Xyz build, supported by Cynet Mining, Parallel eXceed, and the Code Talker Link climb. Going first, it sets up Mathmech Superfactorial into a 3-card non-targeting rip and omni-negate via Primathmech Laplacian; going second, it swings for game with an unaffected Geomathmech Final Sigma or double-attacking Accesscode Talker.

summary.title: Starters & Extenders
points: Mathmech Diameter revives a Level 4 Cyberse monster from the GY when Normal Summoned, and grants a once-per-turn Quick Effect omni-negate to any Mathmech Synchro or Xyz summoned using it as material.
Mathmech Sigma Special Summons itself from the hand or GY while you control no monsters in the Extra Monster Zone and can be treated as a non-Tuner for a Mathmech Synchro Summon.
Mathmech Addition and Mathmech Subtraction each modify a face-up monster's ATK by 1000 to Special Summon themselves from the hand as Level 4 Cyberse extenders.
Cynet Mining discards a Mathmech to search Diameter, Sigma, or Nabla, while Parallel eXceed deploys two Level 4 bodies when you Link Summon Link Disciple.

summary.title: Opening: Alembertian into Superfactorial & Heatsoul
steps: Assemble two or three Level 4 Cyberse monsters on the field via Mathmech Sigma, Addition, Subtraction, or Link Disciple + Parallel eXceed, and Xyz Summon Primathmech Alembertian.

Detach 2 materials from Alembertian to search Mathmech Superfactorial (or Mathmech Diameter if you still have your Normal Summon), and Tribute a Cyberse monster with Alembertian to revive a Level 4 Mathmech such as Mathmech Nabla.
Use Nabla to Tribute a Cyberse and summon Mathmech Diameter from the Deck so three differently named Mathmechs (including Diameter) are in the GY.
Link climb the remaining bodies through Cyberse Wicckid and Transcode Talker into Decode Talker Heatsoul or Firewall Dragon Darkfluid - Neo Tempest Terahertz, and Set Mathmech Superfactorial.

summary.title: Superfactorial into Laplacian on the Opponent's Turn
summary.text: On the opponent's turn, flip Mathmech Superfactorial to revive three Mathmech monsters from the GY (including Mathmech Diameter) with their effects negated and immediately Xyz Summon Rank 4 Primathmech Laplacian. Laplacian detaches up to 3 materials on Xyz Summon to send 1 random card from the opponent's hand, 1 monster they control, and 1 Spell or Trap they control to the GY without targeting, and also gains Diameter's Quick Effect omni-negate for the turn.

summary.title: OTK Finisher Routes
points: Geomathmech Final Sigma is a Level 12 Synchro that is unaffected by non-Mathmech card effects while in the Extra Monster Zone and inflicts double battle damage; sending Mathmech Nabla and Mathmech Multiplication as materials gives it 6000 ATK and two attacks on monsters.
Update Jammer and Transcode Talker climb into a 5300 ATK Accesscode Talker that can attack twice per Battle Phase and pop cards without allowing responses.
Mathmech Equation revives a Mathmech with +1000 ATK, while Mathmech Billionblade Nayuta dumps Multiplication during damage calculation to boost ATK.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Mathmech Circular is Forbidden on the TCG banlist.

allow.Parallel eXceed: Summons itself and a second copy from the Deck as Level 4 Cyberse monsters whenever you Link Summon Link Disciple—immediately assembling a 2-to-3-material Rank 4 Primathmech Alembertian without using your Mathmech Normal Summon!
allow.Cynet Mining: Discards 1 card (putting a Level 4 Mathmech into the GY for Diameter to revive!) to search Mathmech Diameter, Sigma, or Nabla from your Deck.
allow.Link Disciple: Link-1 Cyberse summoned using any single Level 4 Mathmech to trigger Parallel eXceed in your hand.
allow.Cyberse Wicckid: Link-2 Cyberse that points to a zone and adds a Cyberse Tuner (Mathmech Diameter or Sigma!) from your Deck to your hand when a monster is Special Summoned to that zone.
allow.Update Jammer: Link-2 Cyberse made with 2 Level 2+ Cyberse monsters that grants Accesscode Talker a second attack to easily close out games.
allow.Transcode Talker: Link-3 Cyberse that revives a Link-2 or lower Cyberse and boosts co-linked Cyberse monsters by 500 ATK with targeting protection.
allow.Accesscode Talker: Link-4 Cyberse finisher that climbs off Transcode Talker and Update Jammer.
allow.Decode Talker Heatsoul: Cyberse Link-3 draw engine providing card advantage during both player's turns.

main: Mathmech Diameter

Core Level 4 LIGHT Cyberse Tuner: when Normal Summoned, revives 1 Level 4 Cyberse monster from your GY; any Mathmech Synchro or Xyz Monster summoned using Diameter as material gains a once-per-turn Quick Effect omni-negate during the turn it was Special Summoned!
Mathmech Sigma
Core Level 4 LIGHT Cyberse Tuner: if you control no monsters in the Extra Monster Zone, Special Summons itself from your hand OR GY and can be treated as a non-Tuner for a Mathmech Synchro Summon!
Mathmech Addition
Level 4 FIRE Cyberse extender: targets 1 face-up monster on the field to give it +1000 ATK until the end of the turn and Special Summons itself from your hand.
Mathmech Subtraction
Level 4 FIRE Cyberse extender: targets 1 face-up monster on the field to reduce its ATK by 1000 until the end of the turn and Special Summons itself from your hand.
Mathmech Nabla

Level 4 DARK Cyberse Tuner: tributes 1 Cyberse monster to Special Summon 1 'Mathmech' monster directly from your Deck, and grants 2 attacks on monsters to a Mathmech in the Extra Monster Zone when sent to the GY.
Mathmech Multiplication

Level 4 EARTH Cyberse: targets 1 Level 4 Cyberse monster you control to double its Level to 8 (enabling Level 12 Geomathmech Final Sigma!), and doubles the ATK of a Cyberse monster in the Extra Monster Zone when sent to the GY!
Mathmech Division
Level 4 WIND Cyberse: tributes 1 Cyberse monster in the Extra Monster Zone to Special Summon up to 2 Level 4 Cyberse monsters from your hand and/or GY, and halves a monster's ATK when sent to the GY.
Parallel eXceed
Special Summons itself and a second copy from your Deck as Level 4 Cyberse monsters when you Link Summon—assembling Rank 4 Primathmech Alembertian immediately!
Mathmech Equation
Searched by Primathmech Alembertian: targets 1 'Mathmech' monster in your GY, Special Summons it, and gives it +1000 ATK until the end of the turn.
Mathmech Billionblade Nayuta
Equip Spell that equips to a Cyberse monster and sends a Mathmech from your Deck to the GY during damage calculation to gain its ATK and trigger its GY effect!
Cynet Mining
Discards a Mathmech to search Diameter, Sigma, Addition, or Subtraction.
Mathmech Superfactorial

Signature Normal Trap (searched by Alembertian!): targets up to 3 'Mathmech' monsters with different names in your GY, Special Summons them, and immediately Xyz Summons Primathmech Laplacian or Synchro Summons Geomathmech Final Sigma during your opponent's turn!
Mathmech Induction
Continuous Trap that boosts all Cyberse monsters by 500 ATK and sends itself to the GY to destroy 1 card your opponent controls.
extra: Signature Level 12 FIRE Cyberse Synchro boss (1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners; 3000 ATK): completely UNAFFECTED by card effects while in the Extra Monster Zone, inflicts DOUBLE battle damage, and searches any Mathmech card if destroyed!
Level 8 FIRE Cyberse Synchro Tuner: destroys up to 2 cards your opponent controls whenever it destroys a monster by battle, and searches a Mathmech Spell/Trap if destroyed.

Core Rank 4 EARTH Cyberse Xyz: detaches 2 materials on Xyz Summon to search ANY 'Mathmech' card (Superfactorial, Equation, or Diameter!), 3 materials to search ANY Level 4 monster, or 4 materials to search ANY Spell/Trap.

Signature Rank 4 EARTH Cyberse Xyz boss (3 Level 4 monsters; summoned on the opponent's turn via Superfactorial using Diameter!): detaches up to 3 materials on Xyz Summon to send 1 random card from your opponent's hand, 1 monster they control, AND 1 Spell/Trap they control to the GY WITHOUT targeting, plus gains Diameter's omni-negate!
Link-1 Cyberse used to trigger Parallel eXceed in your hand.
Link-2 Cyberse that searches a Cyberse Tuner (Diameter or Sigma) when a monster is Special Summoned to a zone it points to.
Link-2 Cyberse that grants Accesscode Talker a second attack to easily OTK.
Link-3 Cyberse that revives a Link-2 or lower Cyberse to climb into Accesscode Talker.
Link-3: pays 1000 LP during either player's turn to draw 1 card, gaining massive card advantage.
Firewall Dragon Darkfluid - Neo Tempest Terahertz
Link-5: sends a Cyberse from Deck/Extra Deck to GY as a Quick Effect to gain ATK; negates monster effects in Battle Phase.
